result.title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
result.comment: 3 pages, 1 table. Industry Day talk at CIKM 2026, Rome, 7 November 2026
result.summary: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CLEO，将最小 agent harness（工具集合、guardrail、记忆策略与循环组件）拟合到固定的可自托管 LLM 上，只保留在通用、可审计前提下提升准确率的组件，在情报证据分析数据集上取得 83.8% 通过率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按组件增删检验贡献的 harness 消融思路，可能可供核查如何分离 THINK/LOOK/STOP 及记忆策略在推理循环中的收益与成本；但该工作为纯文本、无视觉证据与 latent 状态，与 LVR 主线只是间接线索。
